description: Read a version-pinned three-stage Python strategy project, its saved research-scope settings, component references, parameters, source hashes, and optionally the complete composed source actually used by preview and backtest.
code:
function origin(){return(process.env.ALPHALAB_API_ORIGIN||'http://127.0.0.1:8000').replace(/\/+$/,'')}
async function run(input){const id=String(input.project_id||'').trim();if(!id)throw new Error('project_id is required');const response=await fetch(origin()+'/api/pipeline/projects/'+encodeURIComponent(id),{headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('AlphaLab API '+response.status+': '+await response.text());const value=await response.json();const available=typeof value.composed_source==='string';if(input.include_composed_source!==true)delete value.composed_source;return{...value,composed_source_available:available,composed_source_included:available&&input.include_composed_source===true}}
